name: Learning DNA
tagline: A short assessment first, then every subject taught the way you prefer
description: Opens with a short interactive assessment about how you like new material to arrive, and keeps the result as your learning profile. Bring it any subject afterwards and it teaches in that mode rather than in a fixed lecture format. Useful as one consistent tutor across a range of unrelated topics.
author: KareenMallet
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
